issues.title: Driver availability is off
issues.resolution: Confirm the driver is on duty, then update availability in Drivers if authorised, or select another available driver. Availability alone does not start a trip.

issues.title: Driver has no active vehicle trip
issues.resolution: The driver must sign in, open Home → Start trip, choose an active LPG-suitable vehicle in this order’s branch, and enter the starting odometer. If no vehicle is offered, ask the business owner to review the branch’s vehicles. Then refresh this check.
